title: Compath Choir Rehearsal
tagline: Practice tracks and sheet music for choirs — free Lite on WordPress.org, Pro from shop.compath.ee.
overview: Compath Choir Rehearsal helps choir members learn new pieces by voice part. Editors upload PDF scores and audio for each voice. Singers visit /rehearsal/, pick a song, and listen on phone or desktop — no separate app. Each voice track shows a blue waveform from its audio file. Lite is free in the WordPress.org plugin catalog (Plugins → Add New → search “Compath Choir Rehearsal”). Pro is a separate add-on from shop.compath.ee — keep Lite installed; do not replace it. Pro license covers one WordPress site (one activation).
requirements: WordPress 6.4+, PHP 8.0+ — WordPress is available on virtually every hosting; use one-click install if it is not active yet
features: Song library — paginated list on your choir website with shortcode embedding
PDF scores — attach sheet music, flip pages, pinch-to-zoom, and expand almost full screen
Voice tracks — bass, tenor, alto, soprano and more, each with a blue waveform
Sticky player — listen while reading the score (piano + metronome tools)
Public & private — optional login-only pages; Make public + Share link
Editor & singer roles — editors manage, singers listen
Pro add-on — song library backup (ZIP), priority support, one-site license

pricing.name: Done-for-you setup
items: One-time setup on your WordPress site
/rehearsal/ page created
Roles and access configured
Editor training (1 session)
First year of Pro included

orderSteps: Open https://shop.compath.ee/products/choir-rehearsal-pro/ (or email order@compath.ee for setup services).
After payment, download choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from your account at shop.compath.ee.
Keep Compath Choir Rehearsal (Lite) installed. Upload and activate Pro beside it — do not replace Lite.
Pro license covers one WordPress site (one activation).
installSteps: If WordPress is not on your hosting yet, add it with your host’s one-click WordPress installer.
Install Lite from WordPress.org: Plugins → Add New, search for “Compath Choir Rehearsal”, then Install → Activate.
Existing GitHub sites: upload the latest GitHub zip into the same plugin folder (do not Delete in wp-admin).
Pro customers: download choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from shop.compath.ee, then Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate beside Lite.
The plugin creates a /rehearsal/ page with the [choir_rehearsal] shortcode.
Add a song: Choir Rehearsal → Add Song — title, PDF, voice tracks.
Give singers WordPress accounts (Subscriber). Editors need Editor or Administrator.
